remarks: Welcome to 31 High Street, located in vibrant South Norwalk-just moments from the Wall Street Center, local restaurants, shopping, and everyday conveniences. This stylish one-bedroom townhouse is available for immediate occupancy and offers a comfortable blend of modern updates and practical amenities. The home features gleaming dark wood floors, a renovated kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, and an updated full bath. Central air conditioning, ceiling fans, and a spacious, private bedroom provide year-round comfort. Enjoy the convenience of a garage plus an additional reserved parking space. Ideal for commuters, the property offers easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and the South Norwalk train station. Don't miss this well-maintained unit in a quiet, professionally managed complex.
